newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Didata yr shr surges, details cap award.
newsitem.headline: Didata yr shr surges, details cap award.

text.p: South African data communications firm Dimension Data Holdings Ltd (DiData) on Tuesday reported a 58 percent rise in earnings to 20.5 cents a share in the year to September 30, the company said.

Attributable earnings increased to 84 million rand from 50 million in 1995 on turnover of 1.019 million, a 42 percent rise on last year. Operating income improved by 54 percent to 127 million rand, DiData said in a statement.
The company said it would award capitalisation shares in the ratio of 0.8 ordinary shares for every 100 held to shareholders registered on November 29.

Commenting on the results Jeremy Ord, the company's chairman and chief executive said: "Following an expansion of our interests last year...this year's results reflect strong organic growth and consolidation in the new divisions."
DiData shares have risen steadily since the beginning of the year when they were trading at 197 cents. Shares closed on Tuesday at 10.20 rand, just off a year best of 10.60 touched on October 14.
